protocol.selection_policy: top 20 of 100 by existing fitness; exact ties favor lower ID
protocol.random_parent_policy: sample 20 of all 100 uniformly without replacement, independent of fitness, including early deaths
protocol.matched_reproduction: same 20-parent bottleneck, parent IDs sorted before reproduction in both arms, five offspring each, shuffled birth slots, inherited mutated weights in both arms; never fresh random-brain replacement
protocol.matched_randomness: identical founder genomes and generation-specific physical starts; common mutation seed, masks, Gaussian perturbations, and slot shuffles verified by recorded-draw SHA-256 hashes
protocol.founder_control: frozen original brains, tested in the same held-out worlds; no extra founder training
protocol.primary_family: six two-sided exact paired sign tests: selection-minus-random-parent fitness and selection-minus-founder fitness in each environment; Holm over all six
protocol.intervals: 95% paired percentile bootstrap, 20000 resamples, approximate pointwise intervals
protocol.decision: higher/lower requires Holm p < 0.05 and paired mean interval excluding zero in the same direction. A net selection improvement in an environment requires both primary contrasts higher.
protocol.analysis_unit: one independently initialized seed pair; repeats averaged within environment and pair
protocol.secondary: meals, 60-second survival, drift-minus-founder comparisons, and training trajectories descriptive; no confirmatory p-values
protocol.limitations: causal effect of fitness-dependent parent choice in this virtual-world model and budget, not universal proof; matched evaluation count, not matched lifetime or wall-clock duration; random-parent arm includes both neutral bottleneck drift and mutation
